label: Path Near Stream
literalRoomDescription: The path follows the south edge of a deep ravine and heads northeast. A tunnel heads southwest, narrowing to a rather tight crawl. A faint whirring sound can be heard in that direction. On the east is a ruined archway choked with vegetation.
safeSceneProfile: South ravine edge, northeast path, narrowing southwest crawl and vegetation-choked ruined east archway. No unobserved room contents beyond the arch.

view.message: The ravine is extremely deep. You would never make it.

guardedRoomSource.sourceText:
<ROUTINE STREAM-FCN ()
	 <COND (<VERB? SWIM THROUGH>
		<TELL "You can't swim in the stream." CR>)
	       (<VERB? CROSS>
		<TELL "You'll have to find a ford or a bridge." CR>)>>
